title: Encaustic: Or, Count Caylus's method of painting in the manner of the ancients. To which is added a sure and easy method for fixing of crayons
author: Jean-Henri Müntz

authorInfo.bio: Johann Heinrich Müntz (1727–1798) was an Alsatian-Swiss painter and architect, known when working in England as John Henry Muntz. He was in England for seven years, and at the heart of a group trying to adapt the rococo to architecture and interior design. He has been seen as a pioneer of the Gothic Revival.
